title: Kisan Saathi (Agriculture, Crops & Farming)
description: Comprehensive agricultural guidance: crop diseases, soil health, fertilizer dosing, irrigation, weather precautions, livestock, and government schemes.

chunks.title: Wheat Nitrogen Deficiency & Correction
chunks.text: Nitrogen deficiency in wheat causes yellowing of lower leaves, stunted plant height, and reduced tillering. Correction: Apply 60 kg/ha urea at basal dose and top-dress remaining 60 kg/ha in two splits during crown root initiation (CRI, 21 days) and heading stage. Ensure soil has adequate moisture before urea application.

chunks.title: Wheat Rust (Yellow and Brown) Identification & Treatment
chunks.text: Yellow/Stripe Rust appears as bright yellow linear pustules arranged in parallel lines on leaf blades. Brown/Leaf rust appears as scattered circular orange-brown pustules. Spray Propiconazole 25% EC at 1 ml/litre or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC at 1 ml/litre immediately upon sighting. Repeat in 15 days if infection persists.

chunks.title: Rice Blast Disease Management
chunks.text: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae) manifests as spindle-shaped or diamond lesions with greyish centres and brown margins on leaves, collars, and neck. Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP at 0.6 g/litre water or Isoprothiolane 40% EC at 1.5 ml/litre. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer during cloudy or humid weather.

chunks.title: Phosphorus and Potassium Deficiencies
chunks.text: Phosphorus deficiency shows purplish or dark bronze discoloration on leaf edges and stunted roots; correct by applying Diammonium Phosphate (DAP) at 100 kg/ha at sowing. Potassium deficiency causes burning/scorching along leaf tips and margins; correct with MOP (Muriate of Potash) before flowering stage.

chunks.title: Cotton Pink Bollworm Control
chunks.text: Pink bollworm damages flower buds ('rosette flowers') and seeds inside developing bolls. Install pheromone traps at 5 traps/acre for monitoring. If catches exceed 8 moths/trap for 3 consecutive days, spray Profenofos 50% EC at 2 ml/litre or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 0.3 ml/litre.

chunks.title: Drip Irrigation Water Savings & Soil Testing
chunks.text: Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant root zones, saving 40-60% water over flood irrigation while boosting crop yields by 20-30%. Soil pH between 6.0 and 7.5 is optimal for nutrient uptake. Apply agricultural lime (CaCO3) for acidic soils (pH < 6.0) and gypsum for alkaline soils (pH > 8.2).

chunks.title: PM-Kisan & Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
chunks.text: Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 via DBT. Under PMFBY, premium rates are 2% for Kharif food/oilseeds, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, covering post-harvest and localized calamities.

chunks.title: Organic Pest Repellents (Neemastra & Bramhastra)
chunks.text: Neemastra formula: 5 kg crushed neem leaves + 5 litres cow urine + 2 kg cow dung fermented in 100 litres water for 48 hours; controls sucking pests and caterpillars. Bramhastra: Boil crushed neem, custard apple, papaya, and guava leaves in cow urine; spray at 30 ml per litre for borers.

chunks.title: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) Control
chunks.text: Mustard aphids suck sap from inflorescences, leaves, and pods, curling leaves and stunting seed formation. Economic threshold level (ETL) is 25-30 aphids per 10 cm terminal shoot. Spray Dimethoate 30% EC at 1.7 ml/litre or Thiamethoxam 25% WG at 0.2 g/litre. Spray late afternoon to protect pollinator bees.

chunks.title: Millets (Shree Anna) Cultivation & Water Efficiency
chunks.text: Millets (Bajra, Jowar, Ragi, Kodo, Kutki) require 70% less water than rice and mature in 70-100 days. They thrive in poor soils, endure temperatures up to 45°C, and are naturally gluten-free with high iron and calcium content. Seed rate for Ragi is 4-5 kg/acre; apply 40:20:20 kg NPK per hectare.

chunks.title: Soil Micronutrient Management: Zinc and Boron
chunks.text: Zinc deficiency causes 'Khaira' disease in paddy (chlorotic patches with reddish-brown pigmentation). Apply Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4 21%) at 25 kg/ha to soil or spray 0.5% ZnSO4 with 0.25% slaked lime. Boron deficiency causes fruit cracking in tomato and pomegranate; spray 0.2% Solubor at flowering.

chunks.title: Dairy Cattle Mastitis & Lumpy Skin Disease Prevention
chunks.text: Bovine Mastitis (udder infection) causes swollen, hot udders and curdled or blood-tinged milk. Clean teats with 0.5% povidone-iodine dip after milking and infuse intramammary antibiotic under veterinary supervision. For Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), isolate infected cattle, spray vector repellents, and administer Goat Pox vaccine (heterologous protection).

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme Benefits
chunks.text: Kisan Credit Card provides farmers with hassle-free credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a baseline 7% interest rate. With prompt repayment incentive of 3%, the effective interest rate drops to only 4% per annum. No collateral required for loans up to ₹1,60,000. Covers post-harvest expenses, crop cultivation, and cattle maintenance.

chunks.title: Grain Storage & Pest Protection
chunks.text: Dry harvested grains to below 10-12% moisture content before bagging to prevent fungal aflatoxins and weevil infestation. Clean grain bins thoroughly and line bottom with dried neem leaves. For sealed silos, use Aluminium Phosphide tablets (1 tablet per tonne) strictly under airtight hermetic seal for 7 days.
